questions.prompt: The model sends sql_query with limit 5000, and the schema has maximum 200. What happens?
options: execute runs and cuts the rows to 200
execute runs, and pi logs a warning
The tool never runs and the model gets a validation error
pi changes the limit to 200 and runs the tool
questions.explanation: The schema check comes first. A failing call returns an error result that names the problem, and the tool does not run.

questions.prompt: Why can a schema not stop a DELETE sent in the sql field?
options: A schema checks the shape of the arguments, and a DELETE is still a valid string
pi skips the schema check for strings
The maxLength rule allows only DELETE
questions.explanation: The schema says the field is a string under 4000 characters. A DELETE fits that shape, so telling it from a SELECT needs code.

options: It refuses any field the schema does not name
It lets the model add its own fields
It turns off the schema check
questions.explanation: With additionalProperties false, a call that carries an extra field fails the check and never runs.
